project_id: PVT_... (optional: Projects v2 node id for `factory board`)

gates._require_tests_note: Defaults to true: an empty test_command pauses the queue as misconfigured instead of opening untested green PRs. Set false only for experiments.

review._note: Backpressure: the factory stops claiming work while this many PRs await your review. Omit for no cap.

babysit._note: Answer human review comments on open PRs: a tick runs one agent round on the PR's own branch, pushes the fix or the refusal, and replies in the thread. Off by default.

cheap._pricing_note: Local model, so real marginal cost is ~0. These are API-equivalent shadow prices: they keep the per-ticket and daily budget governors meaningful (a $0 price makes both caps inert) and the ledger then reads as money the 3090 saved you.
